"Noor's ability felt a bit short on multiple fronts, so it is receiving some follow-up changes in order to double down on his shield countering capabilities as well as his survivability. The Horus Lance Launcher will receive multiple improvements to make his ability more reactive, more punishing against ballistic shield operators when they make positioning mistakes, but also more rewarding for the risk Noor takes while equipping the launcher."
HORUS LANCE LAUNCHER
Drilling time reduced on Ballistic Shields, soft surfaces, and solid surfaces (non-destructible surfaces) to 1.5s (from 2s).
Guardbreak strength on projectile impact against ballistic shield operators is increased to 100% (from 30%).
Equipping the Horus Lance Launcher uses Quickdraw animations, equip animation timings are reduced to 0.4s (from 0.9s).
Horus Lance impact damage against an operator is increased to 80 (from 50).
Horus Lance hitbox improvements for better accuracy and consistency.
Horus Lance damages Ballistic shield operators while in the removal animation.

Tachanka's Shumikha Launcher relies on bouncing projectiles to deploy fire. While this allows him to apply pressure without exposing himself to enemy fire, the behavior can be difficult to control in situations requiring precision. Additionally, the delay caused by the bouncing mechanic reduces responsiveness, which can be critical in fast-paced engagements where even small timing differences can determine the outcome of a round.

Therefore, we want to improve usability and responsiveness of the Shumikha Launcher by lowering the skill floor required to use the gadget effectively, while providing players with greater control and adaptability depending on the situation.

Introducing an impact-triggered mode allows Tachanka to respond more effectively in precise or time-sensitive scenarios, improving reliability when targeting specific positions or reacting to enemy movement. At the same time, retaining the bouncing behavior preserves his ability to set up layered denial and control space indirectly. The choice between the 2 modes enables greater adaptability, allowing players to select the most appropriate method based on the situation.
SHUMIKHA LAUNCHER
Added firing mode to trigger Incendiary Grenades on impact.
Solid Snake's Radar provides strong utility across multiple situations, allowing him to apply pressure without much risk.
We want to slightly reduce Snake's overall utility to encourage more deliberate usage and clearer prioritization of targets.
SOLITON RADAR MK III
Precision mode charges: Reduced to 3 (from 4).
We want to improve Valkyrie's ability to set up and leverage her cameras more efficiently, enhancing her ability to create lines of sight without increasing her overall power.
The addition of the Glaive-12 allows her to create lines of sight more quickly and from further.
LOADOUT
Secondary weapons: Added Glaive-12.

These are small adjustments that don’t aim to alter an operator’s overall power level or flexibility. Instead, they focus on polishing gameplay details, improving consistency, and enhancing quality-of-life without shifting the meta. Our goal is to maintain a steady stream of these refinements alongside major updates, helping the game evolve and improve at a constant pace.
We want to improve the responsiveness and reliability of Capitao's fire bolts, ensuring they apply pressure more quickly once deployed.
FIRE BOLT
Expansion: Reduced delay between expansions to 0.9 seconds (from 1).

The Taser only works full power when enemies move toward Clash, while its impact remains significantly low when they run away. This distinction reinforces directional counterplay and encourages players to adapt their positioning during engagements. By increasing the slowdown when enemies retreat we enhance Clash's ability to maintain pressure and control space when enemies attempt to disengage.
TASER
Slowdown: Increased the strength when running away from her to 10% (from 5%).
This change allows Osa to place her shield in a wider range of situations, improving flexibility and reducing friction when setting up positions.
TALON-8 CLEAR SHIELD
Reduced deployment restrictions.
We want to reinforce the threat and clarity of fire-based hazards across the game by increasing their lethality, ensuring that standing or crossing these areas carries more immediate consequences.
Damage: Increased to 14 hp (from 12).
OPERATORS AFFECTED
Capitao
Dokkaebi
Goyo
Noor
Tachanka
Gas Pipes

This change reinforces Barbed Wire as a reliable counter to BU-GIs, giving defenders an additional tool to stop its advance. Defenders are rewarded for proper gadget placement, while Ram players are encouraged to plan deployment paths more carefully and account for defensive setups.
The BU-GIs become entangled in Barbed Wire, stopping completely and self-destructing.

Hey hunters,
How’s the hunting?

We hope you’ve been enjoying Title Update 3! From the Final Fantasy XIV Special Collaboration, to the recent Festival of Accord: Dreamspell event and the arrival of the first 9★ Arch-Tempered monster, Nu Udra!
Speaking of Title Updates, we’re here today to share with you all some cool information about Free Title Update 4, including the news that it will be releasing on December 16!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795648/e3c5536ac24d78edb4dc93b9a429eefec0a94090.jpg"]

On top of that, we’ve got five more pieces of info to share with you today, including Gogmazios, new endgame features, 9★ Rathalos and more! We’ll also share some news on the team’s work on performance and stability improvements for the game!
Gogmazios comes to the Forbidden Lands
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795648/e87d0934135e6740a9b0e1ca5f38c7adc37b770e.jpg"]
Get ready for TU4, featuring the addition of the Elder Dragon, Gogmazios!
🔴 Fire weapon mechanic
🟣 Dragon element weakness
The oil covering Gogmazios's body can be softened with fire attacks, making it easier to land hits, exposing its weakness to dragon element.
New Endgame Related Weapon Features!
As well as the new monster Gogmazios, we're also adding new weapon related endgame features.

Materials obtained from Gogmazios can be used with Artian Weapons of Rarity 8 to create new, stronger Artian Weapons that have one Set Bonus Skill and one Group Skill, chosen at random. (They will retain their existing reinforcement bonuses.)
In addition, Reinforcement bonuses for them are even stronger than those for the standard Artian weapon, so prepare to make further use of reinforcement materials such as Oricalcite!
From today, the following two event quests, which yield Artian materials and Ancient Weapon Fragments rewards, will be permanently available : "King of a Faraway Sky" and "Masterless Claws."
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795648/fda7d35eb8a56b6e896ad37da7ede1501479c92b.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795648/f3d1f70c5a3af7c7bb9321553e5b34334e9faafa.jpg"]
In preparation for TU4, be sure to forge and upgrade your Artian weapons!
Transcend Your Armor & More Armor Spheres!
To help you face the high attack power of Gogmazios, we're also adding a new way to upgrade your armor even further.
Through a process called "Transcending," you can make your armor even stronger than before, after reaching HR 100+.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795648/1ec19ab864071fa4281e1d709c78d8405ffac028.jpg"]
Transcending raises the limits imposed on Armor Sphere upgrades and also enhances the decoration slots on armor of rarity 5 and 6, supporting their viability in late and endgame content.
In TU4, we're also making Armor Spheres easier to obtain, but in the meantime, you can gather them through 7★+ Investigations and Event Quests!
Smelting Adjustments!
We'll be increasing the amount of smelting points gained from some of the monster parts that have not previously been widely used for Oricalcite and Armor Shpere smelting.
Additionally, we'll be implementing the following measures to make Armor Spheres easier to obtain for players.
Permanent Event quest for gathering Heavy Armor Spheres.
Increased the amount of Armor Spheres you gain from Limited bounties.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795648/3dcecff9ad7daca360d71b6f3a5510f01a59d147.jpg"]
9★ Rathalos & Weapon Buffs
9★ Rathalos will appear in certain locales and you can save it as an investigation. You can also create a quest for multiple targets, including 9★Rathalos with other monsters.
We'll also be implementing balance changes (buffs) for some weapon types in TU4. More details on these adjustments coming soon!
Performance and Stability

We remain committed to listening to your feedback and improving both performance and stability of the game. We are targeting Free Title Update 4 to implement a multifaceted plan, including CPU and GPU related optimizations.
That wraps up today’s post, thanks for taking the time to check it out!

We’ll have more information on other TU4 details to share with you in early December in the Monster Hunter Showcase livestream, as well as some exciting new info on Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection! We haven’t revealed an exact date for the livestream just yet, but when we do, you’ll be able to watch it on our official channels:
Monster Hunter Twitch
Monster Hunter YouTube
Thank you all for your continued feedback, support and passion.
We’ll see you in the hunt!
The Monster Hunter Community Team

Monster Hunter Wilds - Free Title Update 2
Lagiacrus Surfaces into the Wilds
At Hunter Rank 31 or above, complete the main mission "A World Turned Upside Down" and the side mission "Forest Doshaguma" to unlock an extra mission featuring Lagiacrus.

The fan-favorite monster, Lagiacrus, has emerged from the depths! Feared as the top of the vast aquatic food chain, these leviathans are capable of discharging a current strong enough to boil the water around them, so hunters who face this monster unprepared will be in for a shock!

In Monster Hunter Wilds, hunters will primarily fight Lagiacrus on the surface. However, battles will also have a special underwater sequence. Even though players will not be able to fully utilize their weapons underwater, we hope everyone enjoys the thrill of taking on Lagiacrus with new underwater action.
Seregios Descends into the Wilds
At Hunter Rank 31 or above, complete the main mission "A World Turned Upside Down" to unlock an extra mission featuring Seregios.

Seregios, known for the sharp, blade-like scales covering their bodies, have descended into the wilds! These fearsome beasts use tempests of swirling talons and razor-sharp scales that cut through the air to inflict their prey with Bleeding. Remember to bring rations and well-done steaks to counter this status effect!
New Tempered Threats
After completing the missions for Lagiacrus and Seregios, each will appear in locales as 8★ tempered monsters at Hunter Rank 41 or above. Will you be able to best these powerful beasts?
Layered Weapons
Customize the appearance of your weapon to pull together an outfit or show off your favorite style!
Craft the final weapon in a tree to use it as layered equipment.

Layered Artian weapons can be obtained by fully reinforcing the Rarity 8 weapon. For weapons that change appearance when upgraded, the pre-upgraded versions will also be available. Forge high-rank Palico weapons to unlock them as layered equipment for your Felyne friend.
New Features
Ability to Swap Handlers
The handler that accompanies you can now be switched between Alma and Erik. Complete the Lagiacrus mission to unlock this new feature.
Mina the Support Hunter
Mina joins the crew of Support Hunters with her trusty sword & shield. In addition, you can now choose which Support Hunters join you on quests.
Photo Mode Enhancements

New features have been added to Photo Mode, such as the Effects tab, where brightness and filters can be adjusted. Your handler, Palico, Seikret, and more can also be hidden using the new Character Display tab. Now you can snap more amazing shots than ever!
Seasonal Event — Festival of Accord: Flamefete: July 23 — August 6

The Grand Hub holds festivities themed around each season. During these seasonal events, the Grand Hub's decorations and meals change to fit the season, and you can obtain unique equipment, gestures, Pop-up Camp decorations, and more! Get ready to beat the heat with this sizzling seasonal event starting July 23.
Arch-tempered Uth Duna Appears for a Limited Time Starting July 30

Arch-tempered Uth Duna will be available to hunt in an event quest and free challenge quest from July 30 to August 20, 2025. Use this chance to forge the Uth Duna γ hunter armor set and Felyne Uth Duna γ Palico set! Hunters who are HR 50 or higher can put their skills to the test against this fearsome foe!

More content is also on the way! From event quests for forging special equipment, to quests for easily collecting Armor Spheres and decorations, and even a Mizutsune Challenge Quest, hunters can look forward to a steady stream of exciting limited-time content!

Monster Hunter Wilds is holding a collaboration with the world-renowned guitar manufacturer, Fender®. From August 27 to September 24, hunters can take part in an event quest to earn a unique collaboration gesture.

The Monster Hunter Rathalos Telecaster®, released worldwide for the 20th anniversary of Monster Hunter, is also coming to the game! Use the collaboration gesture earned from the upcoming collaboration event to rock out with this amazing instrument!

Use the special collaboration gesture to rock out with the Fender® Rathalos Telecaster®! Hunters can look forward to earning this gesture from a collaboration quest that will be available at a later date.

items.text: We've got another round of tweaks coming to Marvel Rivals. We're rolling out a brand-new Chain-CC Protection system to save you from endless stun-locks, Bucky Barnes is trading in his crowd control for pure firepower, and Ultron is expanding his robotic wrath across the battlefield.
[p align="justify"]Let's dive in and see how the meta is shifting!
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]In Season 7.5, we introduced the Chain-CC (Crowd Control) Protection mechanic to ensure combat remains fluid and fair. Here are the specific rules:

[p align="justify"]- The Trigger: If a Hero suffers 5.5 seconds of total CC duration or is hit by 6 CC effects within a 7-second window, Chain-CC Protection activates. This instantly purges all active CC effects and grants the Hero 30% Tenacity for 3 seconds.

Scaling Tenacity: Tenacity proportionally reduces the duration of incoming CC. While active, every new CC effect applied to the Hero increases their Tenacity by 10% and extends the buff's duration by 0.5 seconds.

Total Immunity: If Tenacity reaches 100%, the Hero becomes completely CC Immune until the buff expires. During this window, incoming CC will not grant further Tenacity or extend the Immunity duration.

Cinematic Exceptions: Certain animation-driven CC effects (such as Emma Frost's Carbon Crush and Monster Hulk's World Breaker) bypass this system. Tenacity cannot reduce their durations, nor will they be interrupted if Chain-CC Protection triggers. Any standard CC effects applied during these cinematic moves will be cleared, and Tenacity applied, only after the cinematic ability concludes.
Cooldown: The Chain-CC Protection system has a 5-second cooldown, which begins the moment the final Tenacity effect expires.: [p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Emma Frost
[p align="justify"]We're slightly lowering the energy cost of the White Queen's Ultimate to boost her suppression power on the battlefield. Time to shine, darling!

Reduce the energy cost of Psionic Seduction (Ultimate Ability) from 3400 to 3100.: [p align="justify"]Deadpool (Vanguard): [p align="justify"]We're slightly dialing back Vanguard-pool's burst damage and the survivability gains from his gun-form Ultimate. Gotta keep things fair, even for the Merc with a Mouth!
Reduce The Ban Hammer (Gun Form Ultimate Ability) Bonus Health gained per hammer hit from 80 to 60 (standard) and from 80 to 70 (upgraded).
Reduce The Ban Hammer (Gun Form Ultimate Ability) damage dealt per hammer hit from 45 to 35.

Reduce bonus Attack Speed provided by Deadpool in Your Area - Vanguard to Dual Desert Eagles - Vanguard from 60% to 40%.: [p align="justify"]Peni Parker: [p align="justify"]We're slightly reducing Peni's base survivability but enhancing the deployment range and protection of her Cyber-Webs, while also improving the hit experience of her Primary Attack. This aims to strengthen Peni in positional warfare! Now she can cover more ground with her Cyber-Webs, and flexibly using their support effects will help the team handle specific enemy dives with more ease!
Reduce base health from 700 to 650.
Increase the maximum number of Cyber-Webs that can exist simultaneously on the field from 3 to 4.
Increase Bonus Health cap provided to Peni by Cyber-Webs from 150 to 200.
Increase Cyber-Web Cluster Projectile Speed from 120m/s to 150m/s.: [p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Elsa Bloodstone
[p align="justify"]We're reining in Elsa's mobility and her threat level against Vanguards. The monster hunter needs to pace herself out there in the timestream!
Increase Helix Advance cooldown from 8s to 10s. (Cooldown at max passive stacks from 2s to 4s).

Reduce Monster-Piercer percentage damage per pellet from 1.2% to 0.8%.: Reduce total percentage damage when all 5 pellets hit from 6% to 4%.: Zhiyong Note: When all pellets hit, damage against a 275 HP hero drops from 81.5 (13*5+275*6%) to 76; against a 700 HP hero, it drops from 107 (13*5+700*6%) to 93.: [p align="justify"]Human Torch: [p align="justify"]We're tweaking the Human Torch's mobility mechanics to boost his burst mobility and enhance his gameplay pacing. At the same time, we want his movements to be a bit more predictable for his opponents. Flame on, but with a plan, Rivals!

Plasma Body Mechanic Adjusted: Upon casting, he immediately dashes a short distance (10m) in the direction of movement and enters the Plasma Body state for 4s. This ability now has 2 charges, with a 10s recharge time per charge. There is a 4s cooldown between consecutive casts.: [p align="justify"]Winter Soldier: [p align="justify"]Bucky had a bit too much CC, which caused some serious frustration for enemies, especially when facing dive Vanguards, Duelists, or anchor Vanguards. He felt more like a "bodyguard" than a lethal operative. We're reducing his CC capabilities and slightly buffing his frontal damage output to enrich his combat experience and make him feel like the true soldier he is!
Remove Trooper's Fist Grounded effect on enemies.: Reduce Cooldown from 12s to 10s.
Increase Bionic Hook cooldown from 12s to 15s.
Increase Roterstern Projectile Damage from 75 to 80: Decrease Spell Field Damage from 55 to 45.
Reduce Tainted Voltage single charge energize time from 6s to 5s.
Increase Kraken Impact Culling Threshold from 15% to 20%.: Reduce base damage from 80 to 70.: [p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Adam Warlock
[p align="justify"]We're giving Adam Warlock a little cosmic boost to his healing capabilities!

Increase Cosmic Cluster cooldown reduction provided to Avatar Life Stream per hit on an enemy from 0.3s to 0.4s.: [p align="justify"]Cloak & Dagger: [p align="justify"]We're slightly reducing the duration of Cloak & Dagger's Ultimate.

Reduce Eternal Bond (Ultimate Ability) duration from 13s to 11s.: [p align="justify"]Jeff the Land Shark: [p align="justify"]We're slightly reducing the pressure our favorite land shark puts on the enemy backline. Good boy, Jeff, but let's give them a breather!
Joyful Splash damage falloff now starts at 15m (was 20m) and damage drops to 60% of base at 30m (was 65% at 40m).

Reduce It's Jeff! (Ultimate Ability) recovery time when failing to swallow any targets from 1s to 0.4s.: [p align="justify"]Luna Snow: [p align="justify"]A small encore for Luna Snow to enhance her base combat capabilities!
Increase Light & Dark Ice damage and healing from 22 to 24.: [p align="justify"]Ultron: [p align="justify"]We're expanding the battlefield coverage of Ultron's Ultimate. There are no strings on him!

We've adjusted the logic of Ultron's Ultimate. The four Ultron Drones surrounding Ultron will no longer shoot directly at the crosshair target; instead, they will bombard the area around the target. The bombardment area matches Ultron's, but with slightly lower values. With this adjustment, the coverage area of Rage of Ultron is increased from a 3m radius to a 6m radius.

After activating Rage of Ultron (Ultimate Ability): Increase Ultron's Encephalo-Rays Damage from 8 to 18.: Increase the Drones' Encephalo-Rays Damage from 8 to 12.: New Spell Field Damage Falloff: Starts at 1.5m after Encephalo-Rays explode, with a max falloff to 50% at 3m.: Increase healing effect on allies from 25 to 40.: (Damage and healing effects on targets within the original 3m radius remain roughly the same).: [p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Guardian of the Deep (Venom - Jeff the Land Shark/Hela)

[p align="justify"]Even the Goddess of Death and a ravenous Symbiote have to admit that Jeff's healing hugs were getting a little too powerful. We're dialing back the extra bulk for this aquatic alliance!"
Reduce excess healing converted to Bonus Health from 100 to 50.
Reduce healing efficiency from 70/s to 60/s: [p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Lucky Loan (Black Cat - White Fox/Captain America)
[p align="justify"]What do you get when you cross a master thief, a mystical Kumiho, and the First Avenger? The ultimate heist crew!
As the Team-Up Anchor, Black Cat gains a 5% boost in damage output.
White Fox unlocks the new Nine-Tailed Aura ability through her Team-Up with Black Cat.
Captain America unlocks the new Vibranium Bastion ability through his Team-Up with Black Cat.

items.text: Hey Valley Villagers!
We’re just cackling at having shared a first look at the Season of Scares free update in our latest \[Developer Update] video! Now, let’s dive into what you can expect from this update.

In Season of Scares, you'll meet the trickster Oogie Boogie, from Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas, in a six-week Halloween bash for the ages! This time you'll need to complete a series of thrilling challenges to unlock Jack Skellington's rival and a ghostly canine.
Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Season of Scares free update arrives on September 23, 2026. Check out all the details below!
To kick off the events of Season of Scares, you’ll need to unlock The Peaceful Meadow, Scrooge McDucks's Store and Chez Remy's restaurant.
Investigate a strange mirror that has appeared in Scrooge McDuck's shop and enter it to discover Oogie Boogie's lair!

Now here's the trick – this time instead of unlocking Oogie Boogie first and then tackling his quests, you'll earn your rewards and unlock him by playing through his tricky challenges, from September 23rd to November 4th.
Complete all six weeks of Oogie Boogie's challenges, from choosing to (or not to) go along with his schemes, all the way to a final showdown — to permanently welcome him into your Valley!

At some point in your weekly trials, you may encounter a ghostly loyal companion ... That’s right – in one of Oogie Boogie’s quests you’ll be able to unlock Zero, from Disney Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas.

Beware, after November 4th, Oogie Boogie will be leaving the Valley until Halloween next year... but worry not! As long as you begin the first of these quests before November 4, you’ll be able to unlock Oogie Boogie and Zero at your own pace.

Along with the Season of Scares arrives the frightfully delightful Haunting Elegance Star Path! Charm all your trick-or-treating guests with new bewitching attires and adorn your Valley with new dark whimsical furniture pieces. Give your house a festive new look with the Tricks and Treats House and get Scrooge McDuck in the mood for a good scare with the perfect Skeleton Scrooge Dream Style.

October 7th marks the return of the Haunted Floating Festival event! Until October 31st, explore the decorated festival grounds to discover new and returning puzzles, and earn exclusive seasonal decorations for solving them!

Then, Starting October 14th until October 31st, the Trick or Treat event is back, featuring an all-new way to earn candy! Collect frightfully delicious Trick-or-Treater's Bounty from around the Plaza, or now, by going door to door, trick-or-treating at houses that feature a jack-o'-lantern outside! New rewards for this year include Disney Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas Halloween Town exterior decorations!
Arriving to the Premium Shop this update is the Evil & Good Witch Bundle, featuring new wickedly magical attires, enchanting new furniture pieces and matching bee-witching companions.

This Halloween you’ll also be able to dress up as Red Riding Hood with a new costume inspired by Disney’s television series Once Upon a Time, complete with its very own new Red Riding Hood Wolf companion!
Stitch will also be embracing the festivities with his new Vampire Costume Stitch Dream Style.

Season of Scares will also come with a new Sinister Bridge Kit, complete with its own garden set, and a new Companion Bundle welcoming Lucifer, from Disney's Cinderella, who arrives with the special ability to chase after critters, gathering rewards and unique Photo Mode poses.
In Season of Scares, we’re introducing the Event Board! This new feature is part of the new introductory Star Path: the Astronomer’s Journey Star Path. See below for more details.
Decoration Presets codes are here! Create and share your Presets with other Valley Villagers using code sharing!
As of this update, you’ll also be able to place some gameplay buildings on floating islands. See below for details.
Finaly, the last rooms in Olaf's Grand Exhibition will be opening, along with all new rewards for those who complete all the exhibition rooms!

You’ll also want to keep an eye out on the Scrooge McDuck Store for brand-new weekly items such as the Aqua Mermaid Backpack, the Scarlet Gothic Chair, the Cozy Autumn Bed, Botanical Vine Flower Lamp, and more.
Seasonal Moonstone packs will also be available for a limited time.

Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition does not include access to the Premium Shop. In addition, the Haunted Elegance Star Path on Apple Arcade will be delayed until later this October, and both the Event Board and Astronomer’s Journey Star Path will only be available in our next free update.
Final Rooms and Completion Rewards
Finally, Olaf's Grand Exhibition will be opening its two final rooms based on the Forgotten Lands and Valley Plaza.
The Plaza exhibition room will come with 2 Dioramas and a companion Habitat.

Each time a room is completed, a Biome icon will appear on the lobby carpet. Once all 8 rooms are completed, 3 chests containing the Grand Exhibition’s completion rewards will appear. These rewards will consist of two stunning new furniture pieces – the Grand Exhibition Window and the Grand Exhibition Fountain – and a delightful new Scholarly Fox companion for all your hard work.
Presets Code Sharing
Decoration Presets codes are here!

Create and share your Presets with other Valley Villagers using code sharing! By selecting Share Presets in the Presets option menu, you'll now be able to generate a unique code that can be given to others to use.
Codes are valid for 14 days, even if the creator of the Preset has changed or removed their creation.
We've also updated the Mirage function.
If an item can be found in the Premium Shop, you will be redirected to it.
If the item is from a current Star Path, it will redirect you to the correct page.
If the item was from a limited series or bundle, and/or is not currently available, you will see a pop-up saying, “This item is not available for now.”
Mirages in Edit Mode
Remove creative blockers with Mirage, or two.

If you’re low on decorations when using the Duplicate option in Edit Mode, you will no longer need to stop and go searching for items. Instead, you’ll place a Mirage placeholder and be able to continue creating!
Floating Islands

As of this update, we're helping further unlock your decorative creativity by allowing for some functional buildings around the Valley and stalls, including most character stalls, to now be placed on floating islands.

notes.title: The following can be moved to any Floating Island

items.text: Tiana’s Palace
The Boutique
Olaf’s Grand Exhibition
Stables
Valley Visit Station (however, you won’t be able to interact with it when it’s on a Floating Island).
WALL•E's Garden
Moana's Boat
Beast's Greenhouse
Aladdin's Gem Stall
Kristoff’s Stall
Mulan’s Tea Stall
Tiana's Meal Stall
Expansion versions of these buildings and stalls can also be moved to that expansion’s floating islands.
New Biome Crafting Recipes
We're expanding the new Biome-specific crafting recipes!
In Season of Scares, you’ll be able to complete a mysterious array of new witchy-inspired arcane furniture pieces for your Forest of Valor.
Clear Biome
Finally arriving in this update is an all-new way to remove items from any of your Biomes!

You ‘ll be able to toggle and choose if you want to clear Furniture (furniture and decorations), Landscaping (decorative trees, bushes, and rocks), Fences, and/or Paths from any decorated Biome (or Sub-Biome for expansions).
Apple Arcade Star Path

That's right, if you play on Apple Arcade, you'll now also get new Star Path events every update! The first Apple Arcade Star Path, Haunting Elegance, will launch later this October. These will function similarly to the regular Star Paths on consoles, with the following differences:
There will be no Premium Track or Premium Rewards.
There will be no Moonstones or purchasable Tokens.
Weekly Routine Duties will be replaced by Daily Duties.
Instead of Routine Duties engagement unlocking Vault rewards, you will have Daily Duties unlocking “Milestone Rewards”.
These rewards will be made up of consumable items like Star Coins, Dreamlight, Potions, etc.
New Introductory Star Path
Participate in a new permanent Star Path: The Astronomer's Journey Star Path.
After having unlocked your first realm and speaking to Merlin, you'll be able to start completing this new introductory Star Path.
Progress at your own pace by completing quests around the Valley to unlock special astronomy-based rewards.
As with all other introductory quests, this Star Path can only be completed once.
For Apple Arcade players, this will be available in our next free update.
Event Board
In this update, we’re introducing the Event Board.
While completing The Astronomer’s Journey Star Path, you will be introduced to the new Event Board, which you’ll be asked to place in the Plaza.
The Event Board is a physical item in your Valley that allows you to keep track of up to three live events without having to search your Menu!
For Apple Arcade players, this will be available in our next free update.
We've made improvements to Photo Mode that will make it easier than ever to share your favorite pics!
My Saved Photos
You’ll now be able to save up to 12 photos from Photo Mode.
These saved pictures can be viewed, submitted to DreamSnaps (if eligible), shared with friends (by creating a QR code), or shared to your DreamTeams feed.
Saved pictures can be deleted at any time.
DreamSnaps Archive
Your recent DreamSnaps submissions will be auto saved in the DreamSnaps Archive once the Challenge is done, and results are sent, for up to 6 months.
You’ll also be able to pin up to 3 favorites to keep them!
Pinned DreamSnaps are never auto-removed.
Unpinned DreamSnaps are removed once their expiration timer runs out.
QR Codes
You’ll now be able to generate QR codes for your saved pictures that will last 7 days.
You’ll be able to have 12 codes at a time.
Also important to note that your Photo Gallery and DreamSnaps Archive will live on your online profile, so you'll want to stay signed in and active to keep them saved!
If you don't play for 180 days, Saved Photos and DreamSnaps Archive entries are deleted automatically.
Finally, sharing a photo on the DreamTeams feed or generating a QR code doesn't remove it from your Photo Gallery.
Emotes Wheel
You'll now be able to strike a pose and emote outside of Photo Mode with the new Emote Wheel!
At launch, there will be 11 free emotes available for use.
You’ll be able to perform these emotes in multiplayer and watch your friends react to them, or around your own Villagers and see their reactions!
Super Votes
Introducing a new “Super Vote” option!
To help reward the most mesmerizing submissions, you’ll be able to vote for BOTH presented DreamSnaps at the same time using a Super Vote!
You’ll have 2 Super Votes per day.
Updated Visual Interface
We’ve updated the UI in the 1v1 voting screens to standardize the way DreamSnaps are presented. This means both images will occupy the same amount of space.
You'll still have the option to view any image in “full screen” before voting.
Map Improvements
We've started rolling out improvement on the Map that will help reduce clutter, contains more information, and overall makes it easier to interact with your Villagers:
Map Uncluttering which redistributes the character icons when they are in the same building.
Cursor proximity mode makes icons fan out when the cursor is placed over them for simpler selection.
On-hover cursor info is updated.
A new Avatar orientation indicator tells you which way you’re facing.
Missing labels, icons, and caves have been added.
And Fast Travel improvements, like opening on the Favorites by default.
More Map improvements will be rolled out in future updates, so stay tuned!
New Shop Bundle Type
For the first time, you'll be able to update Villager Houses with their own House Skins, starting with the Snowy Beast’s Castle!
General Economy Update

In the Season of Scares, we've rolled out updates on the value of various in-game content, like the cost of unlocking Realms, or Villager houses, to provide an overall more cohesive gameplay experience. See details here: LINK

releases.displayName: The Pumpkin King Returns Update Patch Notes

items.text: Hey Valley Villagers!
It’s patch notes day – and we’ve got a lot of exciting new content and bug fixes to share with you!

The Pumpkin King Returns Update marks the end of early access for Disney Dreamlight Valley, but we’re not slowing down on sharing free updates filled with exciting content! The Master of Fright himself, Jack Skellington, can’t wait to ring in the holidays with you, so keep an eye out for signs of him around your village. We’re also excited to bring a touch of frosty fun to your Valley with our new Royal Winter Star Path, featuring iconic wintery Dream Styles for Belle and Ariel and more exciting cozy additions. We’re also introducing new quality of life features and bug fixes.

Get ready to welcome the Pumpkin King to your Valley! Jack Skellington arrives along with new quests and unique items that will help bring the excitement of Disney Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas to your Village.
An all-new multiplayer mode comes to the game with Valley Visits. Hang out, share items, and collect new Pixel Shards to craft powerful cooking and crafting buffs!
Make your Valley into a royal winter wonderland with the new Royal Winter Star Path.
Explore new optional items in the Premium Shop for a limited time.
Complete new weekly DreamSnaps challenges to show off your unique style and win Moonstones.
Keep an eye out for gifts and wrapping paper around the Valley with the return of the holiday event.
Knee length versions of basic skirts added to provide you with more outfit options!
Have more control over your Valley with the ability to add and remove Villagers using the map menu. Please note that villagers will always appear in your village if required for a quest.
Some characters have received updates to their animations – enjoy catching them emoting across your Valley!
Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time expansion pass is available now, offering the first of three epic Acts! Click here to see what you can expect.
Disney’s Beauty and the Beast, Frozen, Mickey and Friends, and Moana furniture collections feature small changes in color and shape, all aimed at creating a more cohesive and unified look.
Goofy’s Signature Hat is now more iconically Goofy – it has been sized up to match his own hat in-game.
Adjusted hem length of cropped tops to match length of “Heart of Te Fiti” Camisole.
Minnie’s Dinner Party Gown hem lengthened.
Roughed up Ralph’s Sturdy Overalls by removing the patches and adding signs of wear and tear.
Mickey-Mouse-Patch Jean Jacket back patch adjusted.
Moana’s fishing stall adjusted to more accurately depict her wa'a kaulua.
A bug related to the Pumpkin House not correctly appearing in the Forgotten Lands for some players has been fixed.
“Deal of the Day: The Chocolate Fountain”: A bug related to the spawning of ice shards has been fixed.
“Strut Your Stuff: a bug related to the spawning of Sunbird feathers has been fixed.
“Lair Sweet Lair”: A bug related to the spawning of paper has been fixed.
“The Great Blizzard”: A bug related to the spawning of water particles has been fixed.
“A Broken Sled”: A bug related to the game freezing while trying to pick up the sled has been fixed.
“What Home Feels Like”: a bug related to the secret chest spawning has been addressed to unblock any players who encounter the issue.
A bug related to Lioness Statue in the Forest of Valor becoming unreachable has been addressed.
A variety of bugs related to the appearance of certain items, including furniture and level blockers when viewed with certain graphical settings, has been fixed.
An issue with villagers spawning too close to each other, causing graphical issues, has been fixed.
Want to stay up to date on all things Disney Dreamlight Valley? Sign up for newsletter updates here, bookmark our Trello Issue Tracker, and be sure to follow us on our social media channels:

Twitter: https://gmlft.co/DDV-Twitter

items.text: 1.2.3 Build #47693 December 5, 2023
Starting on December 5, battle legions of Zir’s minions and race against time in a new endgame pinnacle dungeon, Abattoir of Zir. For more information, visit this article.[/*]
A full list of possible affixes can now be previewed in the Enchantment menu using the new View Possible Affixes button.[/*]
Earned Glyph experience from most Nightmare Tiers was increased.
Tiers 1-17: No Change.[/*]
By Tiers 30: From 66 to 79.[/*]
By Tier 50: From 106 to 139.[/*]
By Tier 75: From 156 to 239.[/*]
By Tier 100: From 206 to 339.[/*]

Developer’s Note: After reviewing gameplay data and player feedback, we recognized that completing higher Nightmare Tiers was not as rewarding as we initially hoped for, with many players stopping their journey after reaching Tier 50. The experience increase to Glyphs at higher Tiers was made with the intent of incentivizing players to push their builds, making their arrival at Tier 100 feel that much more fulfilling. We will monitor how this change in experience pans out for players and encourage you to provide us with any feedback you have around this system.
Introduced further support for NVIDIA Reflex technology. Visit the in-game settings to enable this feature.[/*]

Developer’s Note: A previous Hotfix allowed players to walk through Blood Wells to access Potent Blood. This change reverts the ability to walk through Blood Wells, but in exchange, Potent Blood will no longer spawn in the middle of Blood Wells so it can be easily picked up.

Developer’s Note: If they choose to play through the Campaign, players that haven't yet unlocked Mounts must complete the Donan's Favor quest to unlock them. If the campaign is skipped, you must reach Level 25 before unlocking Mounts. The tooltip previously mentioned Quest completion only, which is irrelevant when skipping the Campaign.
Fixed an issue where navigating to the Season Journey from a Seasonal Aspect wouldn't open the correct chapter.[/*]
Navigating the Seasonal Stash with a controller will now be more consistent.[/*]

Press the Active Ability button to activate Omnipresent Evil. The Slasher becomes invisible and gains Undetectable, but cannot see Survivors or their Scratch Marks. Mist Clouds reveal the location of Survivors who are not moving. Footprints reveal the path of Survivors who are walking or running.
Omnipresent Evil is deactivated by using Jump Scare.

While Omnipresent Evil is activated, look at a Pallet, Breakable Wall, or Window to quickly move to it and perform a special-break or special-vault action. The Secondary Action button switches the side you will face when performing Jump Scare.

While in a Trial, repeated positive or negative gameplay modifiers and status effects are now affected by diminishing returns.
Identical Killer and Survivor modifiers granted by Powers, Items, Perks and Offerings will now be reduced progressively as they become stacked.
The following apply diminishing returns only within their role:
Negative action speed modifiers
Positive skill check chance modifiers
The following are excluded entirely from diminishing returns:
Modifiers granted from Add-ons
The gameplay modifier with the highest absolute value is always applied, while lesser ones are progressively lowered to a percentage of their original value.
The game prioritizes the highest values, reducing the impact of lesser ones.
1st value (highest) - 100% of modifier
2nd value - 50% of modifier
3rd value - 25% of modifier
4th value - 12.5% of modifier
5th value and up - 5% of modifier
Game manual updated to include information on diminishing returns.

Following PTB, the following gameplay modifiers now apply diminishing returns only within their role:
Negative action speed modifiers
Positive skill check chance modifiers

Dev note: Thank you for your feedback during the 9.6.0 PTB period! Following reports, we have appended the diminishing returns system to exclude specific modifiers to maintain intended interactions. Notably, negative modifiers will now only apply within the same role. We discovered during PTB that negative modifiers from Killer and Survivor sources were reducing each other, causing self-inflicted penalties to be lessened and gameplay outcomes not working as intended.

On 9.6.0 PTB, for example, the self-inflicted 30% cleansing speed penalty from the Survivor Perk Calm Spirit was being reduced by 50% when calculated against the starting 60% cleansing speed penalty from the Killer Perk Hex: Thrill of the Hunt. Similarly, we found that positive modifiers for skill checks also needed this intervention. The Survivor Perk ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR! was causing Killer Perks like Unnerving Presence to have their effects reduced, which caused skill checks less likely to appear than the intended total increase.
While this ultimately increases complexity, this change guarantees that Survivor and Killer modifiers from Loadouts always work as intended by Players selecting them.

With this patch you’ll be able to express yourself like never before — it includes over 100 new customization options for V, adds CrystalCoat™ compatibility for select vehicle brands, introduces a brand-new TWINTONE™ color scheme feature for CrystalCoat™-compatible vehicles, and more! Photo Mode also received a major overhaul with new camera options, aspect ratios, light sources and posable NPCs, just to name a few things!
Read about all changes in the patch notes below.

Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ technology, initially designed for Rayfield vehicles only, has now been adopted by other car manufacturers. You can now change the paint jobs on Herrera, Mizutani, Quadra and Villefort vehicles. Pro tip: Use CrystalCoat™ to fool the cops and lower your NCPD wanted level!

Kiroshi presents TWINTONE™! As CrystalCoat™ continues to in gain popularity, TWINTONE™ takes your paint jobs to the next level. Simply scan a car with your Kiroshi optics, switch to the TWINTONE™ tab, then save the vehicle's color scheme for a small fee. You'll then be able to select the scheme in the TWINTONE™ database under the CrystalCoat™ menu. There, you'll also find generic color schemes for all CrystalCoat™-compatible vehicles as well as unique color schemes exclusive to the vehicle model from which they were copied. Please note that color scheme cloning is not authorized on vehicles that are linked to quests, belong to the NCPD or that are incompatible with CrystalCoat™ tech.
All vehicles compatible with CrystalCoat™ and TWINTONE™ are marked with a spray can icon on Autofixer.
The ten most requested vehicles from the streets of Night City are now available for purchase on Autofixer:
Mizutani Shion MZ1
Mizutani Shion Targa MZT
Thorton Galena GA32t
Thorton Colby CST40
Archer Quartz EC-L r275
Quadra Type-66 640 TS
Quadra Type-66 680 TS
Mahir Supron FS3-T
Villefort Deleon V410-S Coupe (Phantom Liberty only)
Mizutani Hozuki MH2 (Phantom Liberty only)
Following Act 1, Johnny will now sometimes appear in the passenger seat while V is driving to comment on and react to what's happening.
We've overhauled Photo Mode and added multiple community-requested features:
Drone Camera is now a free camera instead of an orbital camera centered around V.: Increased camera range.
Full Collision (ON/OFF) - determines whether the camera respects in-game object collisions.
Lock Camera (ON/OFF) - locks the camera to avoid misclicking and ruining the frame.
Precise Camera (ON/OFF) - slows the camera down for easier aiming.
Aspect Ratio (PC-only. Custom-resolution screenshots are not available on consoles. Console systems can only export images in the standard 16:9 format.)
Characters tab: Spawn up to 3 NPCs for your photo, with a list of over 20 characters to choose from. You can adjust their expression, pose and position.
Lighting tab: Spawn and adjust light sources.
Fixed the Depth of Field ghosting issue.
Added an Effect Intensity slider.

SmartFrames™ by Kiroshi allows you to display your Photo Mode shots in-game by interacting with the picture frames in V's apartments. Browse your photo collection in the new Gallery menu tab located alongside Journal, Shards and Tarot. The Gallery pulls .png images from the screenshots folder on your PC or from your console gallery. For more details on SmartFrames™ and the Gallery, see this Support article.
32 eye colors
18 lip makeup types
17 nail colors
10 cheek makeup types
16 eye makeup types
4 face scars
5 eyebrow shapes
4 face tattoos
2 body tattoos
8 cosmetic face cyberware options

Upgraded the Character Creator randomizer to feature a new Plain-to-Punk slider. Whether you're aiming for an understated, casual look or a bold, edgy style for your V, you can now use the slider to strike the perfect balance.
Added more secrets to discover in Night City.

Rephrased objectives for quests that tell you to wait a specific amount of time to progress. The game is designed in a way that doesn't always allow players to simply skip in-game time to advance the objective, instead requiring them continue playing to trigger the next event.
Cyberpsycho Sighting: Where the Bodies Hit the Floor - Fixed an issue where no shard could be found on the cyberpsycho's body, blocking progress.
Dream On - The Trauma Team AV on the roof will now be properly hidden in stealth mode.
Heroes - Fixed an issue where the quest, despite being completed, could remain marked as incomplete in the Journal with the optional objectives "Talk to Padre" and "Talk to the Valentinos."
Balls to the Wall - Fixed an issue where it was impossible to exit the elevator and talk to Yuri because of an invisible wall.
Firestarter - Fixed an issue where fast travel could be blocked if the player saved the game soon after exiting Reed's car.
Gig: Waiting for Dodger - After being freed, Bill and Charles will now be more mindful of their driving and avoid running over Dodger’s goons, preventing any unnecessary combat.
Hi Ho Silver Lining - The VIP section in the Heavy Hearts club will now be accessible to players who couldn't meet with Mr. Hands due to a keycard being required to use the elevator.
I've Seen That Face Before - The garage door preventing players from reaching the meeting point will now be open.
Run This Town - The elevator in the Heavy Hearts club is now back in service, so V can finally meet with Mr. Hands.
Somewhat Damaged - Fixed an issue where the prompt to unplug the cables from the Neural Network system was missing.
The Killing Moon - Fixed the issue of a wall blocking the path when carrying Songbird to the shuttle.
Fixed one of the katana finisher animations so that it properly decapitates enemies.
Iconic Synapse Burnout and Iconic System Collapse quickhacks will now be properly affected by the RAM cost reduction buff.
The icons for Tier 5+ and 5++ Behavioral Imprint-synced Faceplate will now be visible on the HUD while driving.
Fixed an issue causing the Synaptic Accelerator to stay active indefinitely if the player is detected while not in combat.
The car horn will no longer honk when the player reloads a weapon during vehicle combat while playing with a controller.
Fixed an issue where the NCPD could stop functioning properly after V engages in a shootout in Pacifica between the Voodoo Boys and Trauma Team.
Fixed an issue where TV program sound was muted or too quiet.
Fixed an issue where CrystalCoat™did not apply properly after entering a vehicle.
Due to popular demand, we've lowered the Trauma Drama high scores.
Adjusted V’s mouth movement in various scenes, including the endings.
Fixed the issue of voiceover cutoff during the Ebunike station announcement on NCART.
Fixed ray-traced shadows for V in Photo Mode.
You will now be able to properly rebind W and S to different actions other than their default settings in the Vehicle category.
Optimized threading system to improve performance by up to 33% on Intel Arrow Lake based CPUs.
Added more Razer Chroma effects for some sections in Phantom Liberty and romance scenes.
